consensus_findings.description: Nit: Isolation ladder provenance is computed then discarded, so coordinator-unreachable decisions cannot record which rung produced isolation. `resolve_isolation()` returns `IsolationResolution(value, source)` with `router|agents_yaml|default`, but `skills/coordination-bridge/scripts/routing_fallback.py` and `agent-coordinator/src/model_routing/resolver.py` keep only `.value` when building assignments. `RoutingProvenance.source` is only `coordinator|local-static`, not the isolation rung. This leaves the vendor-dispatch scenario “Coordinator-unreachable yields a decision… SHALL record which rung” unmet, even though `openspec/changes/pin-isolation-contract/change-context.md` marks that requirement as pass.

Nit: The same provenance drop exists on the coordinator emit path. `resolver.py` calls `resolve_isolation(...).value` and stores only `isolation` on `RoutingAssignment`, so even reachable-router assignments never carry ladder provenance required by design D2 (“provenance must remain observable”).

Optional: `review_dispatcher.py` parses per-mode `isolation` into `ModeConfig` as an unconstrained `str | None` and never validates it against `isolation_contract`. The vendor-dispatch scenario “An unrecognized isolation value is rejected” requires fail-closed behavior when a present value reaches the dispatch layer. Design D3 defers enforcement/execution wiring, but accepting `container` (or any free string) into the parsed field still leaves a fail-open parse path; the field is currently write-only, so impact is latent until dg-06 consumes it.

Nit: In `specs/vendor-dispatch/spec.md`, the scenario “Absence falls through while invalid presence fails” packs two distinct WHEN/THEN behaviors (absence fall-through vs invalid-present rejection) under one `#### Scenario` heading and omits a blank line before the next scenario. Group 4 reviewability is weaker than one-behavior-per-scenario, even though both branches have WHEN/THEN.

none: Mode-aware isolation emission and fallback parity look correctly wired for this change: `vendor_registry` projects `isolation_by_dispatch_mode`, `resolver` selects by dispatch mode after mode is known, `routing_fallback` loads the canonical `isolation_contract.py` via checkout-root shim (no local vocabulary copy), and static OpenAPI/routing-schema enums are pinned to `ISOLATION_MODES` by test.
